Initial release: Instantly create and export professional job video reels from product demo screen recordings.

- Upload raw footage and describe your desired outcome—AI handles editing and export (no manual timeline work needed).
- Automatic cloud setup checks for necessary tokens and connects seamlessly; informs you when ready.
- Supports quick edits ("cut pauses, add titles, export") with fast turnaround (1–2 minutes for short clips).
- Handles common video tasks: trimming, title overlays, aspect ratio changes, BGM track, and more.
- Export videos in popular formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, etc.) at up to 1080p, with download link delivered.
- Offers clear error handling, credits management, and guidance on maximizing effectiveness for job applications.
